- Suggested initial commit: 12 H100 GPUs + 6 A100 GPUs distributed across two regions (us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 secondary). This supports sustained throughput of ~2.5k tokens/sec aggregate with burst to ~5k tokens/sec for short periods with autoscale/burst pool.
- Rollout: canary in us-west-2 (2 H100, 2 A100 reserved), then add capacity in eu-west-1 after verification (2 week validation window).
- Timeline to PO->Provision->Canary: ~3 weeks if PO signed by Dec 10.

Grace / team — quick internal validation following Grace's note and the attached MAP. Data points / caveats: 

- GPU mix: recommending 80% H100, 20% A100 for initial commit. For the numbers Grace proposed (12 H100 + 6 A100), that translates to 12 H100 / 6 A100. If Stratus wants more cost-efficiency we can swap 2 H100 -> 4 A100 but expect 25-40% throughput drop on typical LLM workloads.

- Regions & counts: us-west-2 (primary): 8 H100 + 4 A100. eu-west-1 (secondary): 4 H100 + 2 A100. This keeps the primary cluster sized for production traffic and a smaller DR/validation cluster in EU.

- Throughput estimates (aggregate): sustained 2.5k tokens/sec across both regions (with autoscale policies tuned), 4.8–5.2k tokens/sec burst using the dedicated burst pool and prefix KV caching. Latency expectations: 95p under 220ms for common prompt lengths (<1k tokens) on H100-backed nodes; A100 will be ~1.3x latency.

- Gaps / blockers: eu-west quotas need validation; Private deployment requires customer KMS/HSM integration — ensure security team gets the key contact. We also need to confirm whether Stratus' network allows peered control plane connectivity for Private (otherwise additional design for air-gapped setup).

Action confirmations:
- Laura to check quotas and cloud account linking (I can assist) — target Fri EOD.
- Aditya to assemble the eval harness and a one-day test plan (sample prompts + throughput ramp) — target Mon 12/07.

I will attach a short perf-run result (internal) to support the H100 numbers.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
